source.task: Compare original Crystal and Adamas LLVM function demand and localize unnecessary generation
source.bounded_context: Adamas HIR to MIR to LLVM bootstrap compiler

claim.text: An inherited virtual demand with no override causes Adamas to materialize one identical HIR body per live empty subclass and then emit a MIR vdispatch wrapper, while original Crystal retains one implementation and a direct call.
claim.scope: empty non-overriding reference subclasses, one Int32 instance method, and reusable LLVM inventory/reachability diagnostics
claim.decay_trigger: Changes to HIR virtual-target replay, inherited-body reuse, MIR class candidate enumeration, LLVM linkage policy, or a contradictory fresh same-source pair

evidence.ref: crystal spec spec/llvm_function_census_spec.cr && crystal spec spec/llvm_function_reachability_spec.cr
evidence.signal: 5 comparator examples and 3 reachability examples pass with zero failures or errors
Original 3026 define and 105 declare; Adamas 2458 define and 178 declare; 680 authoritative matches and 50 provisional shape hints
Original reaches 2977 of 3026 definitions and has 3008 internal symbols; Adamas reaches 1433 of 2458 definitions and all 2636 symbols are external
Zero subclasses yields one body and no dispatcher; eight empty subclasses yield original one body versus Adamas nine HIR bodies plus one vdispatch wrapper
ROBUST for semantic identity census, provisional separation, textual ABI diagnostics, and conservative static reachability triage

verification.dod_signal: Focused specs and syntax checks pass; repeated real-pair reports are deterministic; the empty-subclass function slope is present in HIR and LLVM.

residual_risk: This packet proves one multiplier, not complete attribution of the historical full-selfhost excess. ABI fingerprints compare textual LLVM type shapes rather than named-type layouts. Static reachability does not model every indirect call, alias, ifunc, inline-assembly, linker, or plugin behavior and is never deletion authority. Fresh full Adamas LLVM emission is blocked earlier by an HIR OverflowError, so the old 88504-definition artifact is not a current pair.
